body:
Dear friend,

The grass in the meadow is cut, the sun is hot, and it's haymaking time! Every pair of hands helps.

Will you walk down the farm road and help me bring it in? Count the milestones on the way!
summary: Help Mrs. Hannah bring in the hay.

tasks.where: at Mrs. Hannah's farm (walk the farm road, or take the map)
at the coop by your house
from the jug in your kitchen
